issue_context.title: Workday configuration isn't imported to UI with the same settings as YAML
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The repairs message indicates my existing configuration would be imported automatically. 

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7449908/234920490-dfe5f670-d216-474c-83c5-ce535a6a31cf.png)

While true, both were imported neither had the correct configuration. When I reviewed the configuration, the offset was not defined on one and on both the subdivision of country was not set.

Upon updating the configuration neither change persisted. When I go back to review the configuration the changes were not saved.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7449908/234921279-5ce2e331-fc46-48b8-b98b-24a9c2f68096.png)


### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2023.5.0b0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

Workday

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://rc.home-assistant.io/integrations/workday

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

I have two workday sensors defined.

```yaml
platform: workday
name: Workday
country: GB
workdays:
  - mon
  - tue
  - wed
  - thu
  - fri
```

```yaml
platform: workday
name: Workday Tomorrow
country: GB
workdays:
  - mon
  - tue
  - wed
  - thu
  - fri
days_offset: 1
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
Nothing in the log.
```


### Additional information

_No response_

I was able to fix it just by changing that line to:
```
        new_schema = self.add_suggested_values_to_schema(
            schema, user_input or self.options
        )
```
In my tests it seemed to work fine...
Right, wasn't sure as `self.options[CONF_PROVINCE]` is stored different than presented but obviously it works and much cleaner.
